title: Magnetic Force on Current-Carrying Conductor
notes: Magnitude: $F = I L B \sin\theta$, where $\theta$ is angle between conductor and field.

title: Radius of Circular Path in Magnetic Field
notes: Centripetal balance: $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB$ when $\vec{v} \perp \vec{B}$.

title: Pitch of Helical Motion

title: Biot-Savart Law & Constants
notes: Relates current element to field contribution at displacement $\vec{r}$.

title: Field on Axis of Circular Loop (Element)
formula: $$dB = \frac{\mu_0 I d\ell}{4\pi (R^2 + x^2)}, \quad dB_x = dB\sin\phi = dB\left(\frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2+x^2}}\right)$$
notes: Components perpendicular to axis cancel out by symmetry; axial components sum up.

title: Field on Axis & Center of Circular Loop
formula: $$B_{\text{axis}} = \frac{\mu_0 N I R^2}{2(R^2 + x^2)^{3/2}}, \quad B_{\text{center}} = \frac{\mu_0 N I}{2R} \quad [x = 0]$$
notes: For points very far on axis ($x \gg R$): $B \approx \frac{\mu_0 (N I \pi R^2)}{2\pi x^3} = \frac{\mu_0 M}{2\pi x^3}$.

title: Ampere's Circuital Law
notes: Holds for any closed Amperian loop with steady currents.

title: Magnetic Field inside an Ideal Solenoid
notes: Near ends of finite solenoid: $B_{\text{end}} \approx \frac{1}{2}\mu_0 n I$.

title: Force Between Two Parallel Current Wires
notes: Parallel currents attract; anti-parallel currents repel.

title: Torque on Rectangular Loop & Magnetic Dipole
notes: $\,\theta$ is angle between magnetic moment $\vec{M}$ (area vector) and field $\vec{B}$.

title: Moving Coil Galvanometer
notes: Radial magnetic field keeps $\theta = 90^\circ$ between area and field vectors.

title: AC: Pure Resistive Circuit
formula: $$v = V_m \sin(\omega t), \quad i = I_m \sin(\omega t) \quad \text{where } I_m = \frac{V_m}{R}$$
notes: Current and voltage are completely in phase ($\phi = 0$).

title: AC: RMS Values & Power in Resistor
formula: $$V_{\text{rms}} = \frac{V_m}{\sqrt{2}}, \quad I_{\text{rms}} = \frac{I_m}{\sqrt{2}}, \quad P_{\text{avg}} = V_{\text{rms}} I_{\text{rms}} = I_{\text{rms}}^2 R$$
notes: Applicable for sinusoidal AC waveforms.

title: AC: Pure Capacitive Circuit & Reactance
formula: $$i = I_m \sin\left(\omega t + \frac{\pi}{2}\right), \quad X_C = \frac{1}{\omega C} = \frac{1}{2\pi f C}$$
notes: Current leads voltage by $90^\circ$ ($\pi/2$). For DC ($f=0$), $X_C = \infty$ (blocks DC).

title: AC: Pure Inductive Circuit & Reactance
formula: $$i = I_m \sin\left(\omega t - \frac{\pi}{2}\right), \quad X_L = \omega L = 2\pi f L$$
notes: Current lags voltage by $90^\circ$ ($\pi/2$). For DC ($f=0$), $X_L = 0$.

title: AC: Series LCR Circuit, Impedance & Resonance
notes: At resonance: $X_L = X_C$, $Z_{\min} = R$, current is maximum and in phase.

title: AC: Power in General Circuit & Power Factor
notes: $\cos\phi$ is the power factor. In pure L or C, $\phi = 90^\circ \implies P = 0$ (wattless current).

title: AC: Transformer
notes: For step-up transformer $k > 1$ ($V_s > V_p, I_s < I_p$); for step-down $k < 1$.
